text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa! For real?! It's a grilled squid 
stall?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking in front of the station, 
Tamamo Cross suddenly let out a loud 
shout.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's rare! When people around here 
say ikayaki, they usually mean whole 
grilled squid!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Alright, then let's get right down to—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"No, wait up... If I eat something like 
this right now, I won't have room in my 
stomach for dinner..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we can just make it a late-night 
snack! You're always hungry before bed 
anyway! No problem at all, right, 
Trainer?!
choice_data_list: It's not good to eat right before bed.
Holding it in is worse for you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Truth is, I knew it all along... 
But seeing this rare grilled squid right 
in front of me...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...No, considerin' my body, a late-night 
snack is definitely a bad idea... Gotta 
endure it... Stay strong, me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after a desperate struggle with 
herself, Tamamo Cross triumphed over the 
temptation of the grilled squid.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You really get it! Holding back is the 
worst thing for your health, seriously!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go buy some! Oh right, might 
as well buy some for Oguri too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tamamo Cross's heart and stomach 
were both filled to the brim.
